candidates.hypothesis: Rapidly brightening transient (Nova or early SN)

history.note: Continued consistent brightening (1.10 mag). Position stable. Alert criteria met.

decision.reasoning: CAND_01 continues its rapid brightening, now reaching magnitude 9.04 with extreme significance (498.4σ). The 19 additional detections in this iteration are clustered within 15 pixels of the primary source and are rejected as PSF artifacts and subtraction residuals caused by the saturation of the primary transient.
